landing.promo: Season highlight: commission- free online booking for guests
landing.heroTitle: One platform for guests and cafe teams
landing.heroSubtitle: Book a table in a few clicks or run the venue from one panel - fast, clear, and welcoming.
landing.guestsLead: Cafe catalog, instant booking, profile and visit history - all in one place.
landing.guestsLi1: Pick time and table for your party
landing.adminLead: One panel: bookings, orders, customers and analytics - less manual work.
landing.whyTitle: Why Torlet for diplomas and pilots
landing.whyText: A clear guest journey and a separate staff area - show the full loop from cafe search to admin analytics.
landing.featuresLead: Everything to demo reservations and back office in one project.
landing.feat_minute_text: Pick venue, date and time - no calls or hold lines.
landing.feat_nearby_text: Catalog with details and easy table choice for your group.
landing.feat_status_text: History and confirmations - all in one place.
landing.feat_adminbiz_text: Orders, guests and analytics in the panel - less routine.
landing.howLead: Three simple steps from idea to booking.
landing.step1_desc: Create an account or log in - your data is kept for next visits.
landing.step2_desc: Open the catalog, read details and book a slot.
landing.step3_desc: Show your booking or name - the team is ready for you.
landing.quote: We focus on comfort and speed: guests skip phone calls, and the team sees live floor load.
landing.quoteBy: Torlet concept · booking for modern cafes
landing.ctaLead: Pick a role - guest and admin routes open right after you go.
landing.footer: Diploma Cafe Booking · demo for coursework
